author: Sally Almuhisen
quote: I am extremely disappointed with both the quality of this bag and BÉIS' customer service.
paraphrase: Trim peeled within three months; poor support.

author: ZM
quote: My laptop fits perfectly and I was pleasantly surprised with how spacious the bag is.

author: Lise-Jasmijn Steegmans
quote: I maybe expected a bit more zipper compartments in the inside, not just elastics.

author: krystal ridley
quote: The zippers are crooked, the bags lack sturdiness, and the lining feels cheap

author: customer (US)
quote: My weekender bag's handles ripped in 2 places after only a few uses.
paraphrase: Handles tore; support blamed wear and tear.

author: yoanna
quote: I fill it to the brim plus laptop and IPAD sometimes and its perfect and durable.

author: Madison Brown
quote: The bags look gorgeous to begin with but they scratch easily and the stitching has all come undone.

author: RGC
quote: the seams have started to come apart and the edges of the bag have started shedding off.
paraphrase: Seams split after under three months of travel; price too high.

author: Louise F.
quote: now the simili-leather is flaking, joints on the handle are flaking as well
paraphrase: Faux leather and handle joints deteriorated within a year.
